features.quote: The turn cap is the only hard stop.
features.justification_quote: premature termination would censor the exact behavior we want to measure
a degenerating model could emit dozens of tool calls in one turn, exploding cost and context
feeding them back verbatim would blow context and cost

features.quote: a runaway subject can't clobber the host
features.justification_quote: reproducibility... speed, and isolation (a runaway subject can't clobber the host)

features.quote: we never `exec` subject code... we must not run model-generated code on the host
features.justification_quote: sandbox safety — we must not run model-generated code on the host
